protocol.statistic: Within each mode/round/group take max of eight per-rank elapsed times,then median of nine rounds. Retain all samples and group-specific results. Check same-host invocation overlap across groups.

terminal_HC.decision: Defer a standalone terminal transport experiment for this decode scope. Keep wider compute, readiness and row-ownership changes in their existing branch contracts.
assumptions: The narrow route requires all raw-plane and coefficient readers to accept the changed publication. If either raw output remains required, this replacement charge does not apply.
The old rank trace binds both gather tasks by task row in each actual terminal window. The reference charge sums separately calibrated medians under a serial fixed-outside-work assumption.
The graph benchmark measures repeated identical calls. A single mixed sequence can have different launch, cache, scheduling and readiness costs.

limits: Scope is captured equal-shape standalone PyTorch/HCCL collectives on two currentTP8 groups with an idle resident service. The AIV pilot records eager and captured dispatch on one leader of each group.
Device-event time per call amortizes sixteen operations in one replay. Values may include local readiness, scheduling and protocol work. Host interval intersection establishes co-issued windows only.

Placement, concurrency, forwarding, layout and graph or eager mode constrain reuse. F21 internal EP16 phases, physical wire bandwidth, whole-model critical path and C8 gains require their own evidence.
